Route DEMO42 – Trip Sheet Directions

Directions listed under each stop are the turns to drive from that stop to the next one.

Run 900.101 – OAK HS 01

06:10 AM – 1 OAK HS (start)

Proceed On OAK HS
Right Turn Onto MAPLE AVE
Left Turn Onto ELM ST
Turn Around On ELM ST

06:20 AM – ELM ST & BIRCH LN – DOORSIDE

Proceed On ELM ST
Right Turn Onto CEDAR CT
Turn Around On CEDAR CT

06:25 AM – CEDAR CT @ THE END OF SIDEWALK

Proceed On CEDAR CT
Left Turn Onto ELM ST
Right Turn Onto OAK HS

06:35 AM – SCHOOL: OAK HS (end)

Run 900.102 – OAK HS 02 (DB)

06:35 AM – DEADHEAD – SCHOOL: OAK HS (start)

Proceed On OAK HS
Left Turn Onto MAPLE AVE
Proceed Onto ROUNDABOUT
Proceed Onto MAPLE AVE
Right Turn Onto WILLOW DR

06:42 AM – WILLOW DR & ASPEN WAY – DOORSIDE

Proceed On WILLOW DR

06:44 AM – WILLOW DR & HAZEL CT

Left Turn Onto HAZEL CT
Turn Around On HAZEL CT
Right Turn Onto WILLOW DR
Left Turn Onto MAPLE AVE
Right Turn Onto OAK HS

06:55 AM – SCHOOL: OAK HS (end)

Run 900.203 – PINE MS 03

07:20 AM – DEADHEAD – SCHOOL: OAK HS (start)

Proceed On OAK HS
Right Turn Onto MAPLE AVE
Right Turn Onto SPRUCE RD

07:28 AM – SPRUCE RD & JUNIPER LN

Left Turn Onto JUNIPER LN
Right Turn Onto PINE MS
Turn Around On PINE MS

07:35 AM – SCHOOL: PINE MS (end)
